headline: Fisherman’s Row Sees Fresh Base Swings
war_summary: Fisherman’s Row has taken the latest turn in the campaign, shifting from five Colonial and four Warden strategic bases in the previous edition to two Colonial and seven Warden. Seven ownership events were logged in the latest two hours and 28 across the day, with fighting now accelerating on both casualty ledgers after a brief hourly lull. Deadlands also moved one base toward the Wardens, standing at seven Colonial to four Warden, with two events in the latest two hours and nine over 24 hours; its casualty pace is cooling by the hour, though enlistments are rising. Linn Mercy remains divided nine Warden to two Colonial, with 15 daily ownership events but none in the latest two hours. Lykos Isle holds at five Warden to two Colonial and likewise recorded nine events over the day, while its immediate battle tempo has quieted. Stlican Shelf remains eight Warden to one Colonial, with six daily events but no fresh movement. Weathered Expanse has no recorded base changes, yet reports the heaviest current losses outside Deadlands, with both sides’ two-hour casualty rates accelerating and enlistments rising.
